inputs.name: Hydrogen, gaseous, 25 bar, from electrolysis
inputs.note: Figure 31: the hydrogen input is '1 MJ / 120 MJ/kg / thermal eff. * allocation factor'. With the 33.0 % heat conversion efficiency of Tab. 55 the unallocated need is 1/120/0.33 = 2.525E-2 kg H2 per MJ heat. The EXERGY ALLOCATION FACTOR is not in this excerpt (the SOFC counterpart of Tab. 50 is missing), so the point estimate assumes a heat share of about 10 % (33 % thermal against 47 % electrical efficiency, low-grade residential heat) and the bounds span a heat share of 5 % to 100 %.

derivation.per: per MJ of residential heat from the SOFC
derivation.mapping_reason: The dataset is fed by PEM electrolysis hydrogen delivered by pipeline, and 'Hydrogen, gaseous, 25 bar, from electrolysis' is the only electrolytic, non-fuelling-station, non-SOEC/AEC-specific candidate; the Moroccan solar+wind feedstock variant does not appear in the list, so this is the closest electrolytic hydrogen at pipeline pressure. The pyrolysis and SMR candidates are the wrong production route and the 700 bar fuelling-station ones the wrong delivery.

emissions.name: Water
emissions.note: Figure 31, blue (biosphere) number: '1 MJ/120 MJ/thermal eff. * 9 kg' = 2.525E-2 kg H2 x 9 kg water per kg H2 = 0.227 kg water vapour to air. The figure prints no allocation factor on this flow although the hydrogen input carries one, so this value may be inconsistent with the allocated hydrogen input above.
